in_marathi.name: Kanusha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Treasure
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kanusha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Kanusha is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Kanu’ which means ‘Krishna’ and ‘Sha’ which means ‘treasure’. This name is often given to girls in Hindu culture to symbolize the presence of God Krishna and the idea of wealth and abundance in their lives.

This name is often given to girls in Hindu culture to symbolize the presence of God Krishna and the idea of wealth and abundance in their lives.
